words.enDefinition: a transfer of funds within the same country

examples.en: I checked whether the form was for a domestic transfer before entering any details.
examples.zh: 我填写资料前，确认了这份表格是不是用于「境内转账」的。

examples.en: The bank showed the domestic transfer on a separate page from my overseas payments.
examples.zh: 银行把这笔「境内转账」和我的海外付款分开显示。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of funds between accounts or people in different countries

examples.en: I asked when my international transfer would appear in the recipient's bank account.
examples.zh: 我问这笔「国际转账」什么时候会显示在收款人的银行账户里。

examples.en: The international transfer confirmation appeared in my mailbox while I was in class.
examples.zh: 我上课的时候，「国际转账」的确认通知进了邮箱。

words.enDefinition: a payment sent into a specified account from elsewhere

examples.en: My bank sent a message about an incoming transfer while I was at the library.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆的时候，银行发来消息说有一笔「转入款项」。

examples.en: I asked which reference matched the incoming transfer on my statement that morning.
examples.zh: 我问那天早上账单上的「转入款项」对应哪个编号。

words.enDefinition: a payment sent from an account to another account or recipient

examples.en: The app showed the outgoing transfer under payments made from my current account.
examples.zh: 应用把「转出款项」列在我活期账户的付款记录下。

examples.en: I kept the reference from the outgoing transfer with my other exchange documents.
examples.zh: 我把这笔「转出款项」的编号和其他交换项目文件放在了一起。

words.enDefinition: a movement of money from one bank to another

examples.en: I asked whether an interbank transfer would have a different reference on my statement.
examples.zh: 我问「跨行转账」在账单上的编号会不会不一样。

examples.en: The app showed that this payment had been sent as an interbank transfer.
examples.zh: 应用显示，这笔付款是通过「跨行转账」发出的。

words.enDefinition: money moved between accounts held with the same bank

examples.en: The bank described moving money between my two accounts as an internal transfer.
examples.zh: 银行把在我两个账户之间转钱称为「行内转账」。

examples.en: I checked whether the confirmation referred to the internal transfer I made this morning.
examples.zh: 我确认了通知里说的是不是我今天早上做的那笔「行内转账」。

words.enDefinition: a transfer intended to be made on one occasion only

examples.en: I chose a one-time transfer for the deposit when I moved into student housing.
examples.zh: 我搬进学生公寓时，给押金选了「一次性转账」。

examples.en: The confirmation said that I had scheduled a one-time transfer for the following day.
examples.zh: 确认通知说，我设了一笔次日执行的「一次性转账」。

words.enDefinition: a transfer arranged to be sent at a future time

examples.en: I reviewed the date on the scheduled transfer in my banking app after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我在银行应用里核对了「预约转账」的日期。

examples.en: The bank asked whether I wanted confirmation once the scheduled transfer had been sent.
examples.zh: 银行问「预约转账」发出后，我是否想收到确认通知。

words.enDefinition: a transfer repeated automatically at regular intervals

examples.en: I checked when the recurring transfer for my shared bills was due to run.
examples.zh: 我查了分摊账单用的「周期性转账」下次什么时候执行。

examples.en: The app listed the recurring transfer separately from payments I had made that morning.
examples.zh: 应用把「周期性转账」和我那天早上手动付的款分开列出。

words.enDefinition: an instruction for a bank to send regular fixed payments

examples.en: My flatmate asked which date the standing order for our shared bills was set for.
examples.zh: 室友问，平摊账单用的「定期付款指令」设的是哪天。

examples.en: The bank's help page explained where to view an existing standing order.
examples.zh: 银行的帮助页面介绍了到哪里查看已有的「定期付款指令」。

words.enDefinition: a transfer designed to make funds available almost immediately

examples.en: I asked whether the instant transfer option appeared for both of my bank accounts.
examples.zh: 我问我的两个银行账户都会不会显示「即时转账」选项。

examples.en: The app called it an instant transfer, but my roommate checked her account first.
examples.zh: 应用把它叫作「即时转账」，不过我室友还是先查了自己的账户。

words.enDefinition: a transfer expected to reach its destination on the sending day

examples.en: I asked the bank about the deadline for a same-day transfer that Friday.
examples.zh: 我向银行询问了那个星期五办理「当日转账」的截止时间。

examples.en: The page showed a same-day transfer option next to the standard delivery estimate.
examples.zh: 页面上在标准到账时间估计旁边列了一个「当日转账」选项。

words.enDefinition: a transfer scheduled to reach the recipient the following day

examples.en: The provider listed a next-day transfer option in the quote I received online.
examples.zh: 我收到的网上报价里，服务商列了一个「次日转账」选项。

examples.en: I asked whether the next-day transfer was expected on the next banking day.
examples.zh: 我问这笔「次日转账」预计是不是在下一个银行工作日到账。

words.enDefinition: a payment sent directly between two financial accounts

examples.en: The portal labeled the tuition payment as an account-to-account transfer on my receipt.
examples.zh: 学费平台在我的收据上把这种付款标成了「账户间转账」。

examples.en: I asked whether an account-to-account transfer would show my name on the recipient's statement.
examples.zh: 我问这笔「账户间转账」在收款人的账单上会不会显示我的姓名。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of money directly between individuals

examples.en: My roommate sent a peer-to-peer transfer for her share of the grocery bill.
examples.zh: 室友用「个人对个人转账」付了她分摊的那部分买菜钱。

examples.en: I found the peer-to-peer transfer in the app after my friend confirmed the date.
examples.zh: 朋友确认日期后，我在应用里找到了这笔「个人对个人转账」。

words.enDefinition: a request telling a provider how to send funds

examples.en: The bank asked me to review my transfer instruction before sending the money.
examples.zh: 银行让我在汇出前再核对一遍「转账指令」。

examples.en: I saved a copy of the transfer instruction with the recipient's confirmation email.
examples.zh: 我把「转账指令」的副本和收款人的确认邮件放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: the sum specified to be moved in a transfer

examples.en: I checked the transfer amount against my tuition notice before confirming the request.
examples.zh: 确认申请前，我把「转账金额」和学费通知上的金额核对了一遍。

examples.en: The receipt separated the transfer amount from the service fee on two lines.
examples.zh: 收据分两行列出了「转账金额」和服务费。

words.enDefinition: the date recorded or planned for sending a transfer

examples.en: I asked which date on the receipt counted as the transfer date.
examples.zh: 我问收据上的哪个日期是「转账日期」。

examples.en: The bursar asked for the transfer date when I emailed about my payment.
examples.zh: 我发邮件询问付款时，学校财务人员让我提供「转账日期」。

words.enDefinition: the date a transaction takes financial effect under bank terms

examples.en: I asked what the value date meant on the statement from my bank.
examples.zh: 我问银行账单上的「资金生效日」是什么意思。

examples.en: The receipt showed the transfer date and value date in two separate fields.
examples.zh: 收据分别用两个字段显示转账日期和「资金生效日」。

words.enDefinition: the date funds are exchanged to complete a financial transaction

examples.en: The bank explained which date on the notice was the settlement date.
examples.zh: 银行解释了通知上的哪个日期是「结算日期」。

examples.en: I asked whether the settlement date was separate from the estimated delivery date.
examples.zh: 我问「结算日期」和预计到账日期是不是不同的两个日期。

words.enDefinition: the day a transfer is estimated to reach the recipient

examples.en: I shared the expected arrival date with my university's accounts office by email.
examples.zh: 我通过邮件把「预计到账日期」告诉了学校财务办公室。

examples.en: The provider changed the expected arrival date after checking the receiving bank's schedule.
examples.zh: 服务商核实收款银行的安排后，更改了「预计到账日期」。

collocations: an expected arrival date for the transfer

words.zhGloss: 转账当日受理截止时间
words.enDefinition: the latest time for a transfer to enter that day's processing
acceptedZhAnswers: 转账当日受理截止时间

examples.en: I checked the transfer cut-off time because my lecture would finish late that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午课会结束得比较晚，所以我查了「转账当日受理截止时间」。

examples.en: The bank listed a separate transfer cut-off time for payments sent internationally that day.
examples.zh: 银行单独列明了当天国际汇款的「转账当日受理截止时间」。

words.enDefinition: a day when a bank processes its ordinary business transactions

examples.en: The receipt said one banking day, so I asked whether Monday counted.
examples.zh: 收据上写着一个「银行工作日」，所以我问星期一算不算。

examples.en: I asked which banking day the provider meant in its arrival estimate.
examples.zh: 我问服务商的到账估计指的是哪个「银行工作日」。

words.enDefinition: an established route for payments between two countries or regions

examples.en: I asked which payment corridor the provider used for transfers to my home country.
examples.zh: 我问服务商向我家乡所在国家汇款时，会用哪条「跨境汇款线路」。

examples.en: The provider listed its fees separately for each payment corridor on the website.
examples.zh: 服务商网站按每条「跨境汇款线路」分别列了费用。

words.enDefinition: transfer funds to a recipient in another country

examples.en: I checked the fee schedule before asking the bank to send money abroad.
examples.zh: 我先查了收费表，再问银行怎样「向国外汇款」。

examples.en: My classmate needed to send money abroad to pay for her exchange accommodation.
examples.zh: 我同学需要「向国外汇款」，支付交换期间的住宿费。

collocations: a way to send money abroad
ask how to send money abroad

words.enDefinition: money sent to relatives, often across national borders

examples.en: The student accounts office asked how I had received the family remittance.
examples.zh: 学生财务办公室问我是怎样收到这笔「家庭汇款」的。

examples.en: I saved the receipt for the family remittance with the other term records.
examples.zh: 我把「家庭汇款」的收据和这个学期的其他账目放在一起留存。

words.enDefinition: a company or bank that sends money for customers

examples.en: The remittance provider gave me a reference to use when calling about the payment.
examples.zh: 「汇款服务商」给了我一个编号，打电话查这笔款时可以用。

examples.en: I asked the remittance provider to send me another copy of the fee disclosure.
examples.zh: 我请「汇款服务商」再发给我一份费用披露文件。

words.enDefinition: a delivery option allowing a recipient to collect cash in person

examples.en: I asked the provider what cash pickup meant on the list of delivery options.
examples.zh: 我问服务商，到账方式清单里的「现金领取」是什么意思。

examples.en: The quote showed fees for cash pickup separately from deposits into an account.
examples.zh: 报价把「现金领取」和入账这两种方式的费用分开列出。

words.enDefinition: a place where a designated recipient can collect transferred funds

examples.en: The recipient asked whether the cash pickup location was near her bus route.
examples.zh: 收款人问「现金领取点」离她坐的公交路线近不近。

examples.en: I checked the cash pickup location address after the provider sent the confirmation.
examples.zh: 服务商发来确认通知后，我核对了「现金领取点」的地址。

words.enDefinition: a payment sent to or from a mobile wallet

examples.en: The provider listed mobile wallet transfer as a delivery option on the quote.
examples.zh: 服务商在报价里把「手机钱包转账」列为一种到账方式。

examples.en: I asked whether a mobile wallet transfer receipt would appear directly in the app.
examples.zh: 我问「手机钱包转账」的收据会不会直接显示在应用里。

words.enDefinition: delivery of transferred funds directly into the recipient's bank account

examples.en: I asked whether bank account payout was available for the recipient's particular bank.
examples.zh: 我问这笔钱能不能「直接发放到银行账户」，也就是汇到收款人用的那家银行。

examples.en: I selected bank account payout because my sister could not collect cash that afternoon.
examples.zh: 妹妹那天下午没法领现金，所以我选择「直接发放到银行账户」。

words.enDefinition: a local organization that delivers funds for a transfer provider

examples.en: The receipt listed the payout partner handling the cash collection at the other end.
examples.zh: 收据上列了在收款地负责现金领取的「付款合作机构」。

examples.en: I asked which payout partner would appear in the message sent to the recipient.
examples.zh: 我问发给收款人的消息会显示哪家「付款合作机构」。

words.enDefinition: the country where funds are intended to be delivered

examples.en: The quote changed when I corrected the recipient country in the online form.
examples.zh: 我更正网上表格的「收款国家」后，报价变了。

examples.en: I checked that the form listed the right recipient country before saving it.
examples.zh: 保存表格前，我确认了上面列的「收款国家」没有填错。

words.enDefinition: the person or organization that sends a money transfer

examples.en: The clerk asked what name appeared under remitter on the transfer receipt.
examples.zh: 工作人员问转账收据「汇款人」一栏填的是谁的名字。

examples.en: I asked the university whether it needed the remitter details for its records.
examples.zh: 我问学校是不是要把「汇款人」的信息留档。

words.enDefinition: information needed to identify the person receiving a payment

examples.en: The bank asked me to review the recipient details before confirming the transfer.
examples.zh: 银行让我确认转账之前，先检查「收款人资料」。

examples.en: I checked the recipient details against the invoice from the residence office.
examples.zh: 我按宿舍办公室发来的账单核对了「收款人资料」。

words.enDefinition: the name of the person or entity receiving the money

examples.en: The bank asked whether the beneficiary name matched the details on the invoice.
examples.zh: 银行问「受益人姓名」是否和发票上的资料相符。

examples.en: I checked the beneficiary name on the form against the university's payment notice.
examples.zh: 我把表格上的「受益人姓名」和学校付款通知上的名字核对了一遍。

words.enDefinition: the account designated to receive the transferred funds

examples.en: My bank asked which beneficiary account was listed on the official payment form.
examples.zh: 银行问正式付款单上指定的是哪个「收款账户」。

examples.en: I asked whether the beneficiary account could receive funds in the specified currency.
examples.zh: 我问这个「收款账户」能不能接收指定币种的款项。

words.enDefinition: the bank holding the account designated to receive the money

examples.en: The form had a separate field for the beneficiary bank and its location.
examples.zh: 表格有一栏单独填写「汇款收款银行」和所在地。

examples.en: I asked which name on the notice referred to the beneficiary bank.
examples.zh: 我问通知上的哪个名称指的是「汇款收款银行」。

words.enDefinition: the address listed for the person or entity receiving a payment

examples.en: I asked whether the beneficiary address meant the person's home or their office.
examples.zh: 我问「收款人地址」是填对方家里的地址，还是办公室地址。

examples.en: The university provided a beneficiary address on its overseas payment information sheet.
examples.zh: 学校在海外付款资料单上提供了一个「收款人地址」。

words.enDefinition: the location recorded for the bank identified in a transfer

examples.en: The clerk checked the bank address against the official details I had received.
examples.zh: 工作人员根据我收到的官方资料核对了「银行地址」。

examples.en: I asked why the bank address and the beneficiary's address were listed separately.
examples.zh: 我问为什么「银行地址」和收款人的地址要分开列。

words.enDefinition: an identifier for a specific branch of a financial institution

examples.en: I asked which part of the published details was the branch code.
examples.zh: 我问公布的资料里哪一部分是「银行分行代码」。

examples.en: The bank's help page explained the branch code field on the form.
examples.zh: 银行的帮助页解释了表格上的「银行分行代码」一栏。

words.enDefinition: an Australian identifier for a bank and its branch

examples.en: My Australian university listed a BSB number separately from its account number.
examples.zh: 我在澳大利亚就读的学校把「澳洲银行分行代码」和银行账号分开列。

examples.en: I asked the bank which field was intended for the BSB number.
examples.zh: 我问银行，哪个字段是用来填「澳洲银行分行代码」的。

words.enDefinition: a number identifying a bank branch in Canadian payment details

examples.en: The Canadian bank printed the transit number beside the institution number on my form.
examples.zh: 加拿大的银行把「加拿大银行分行编号」印在我的表格上的机构编号旁边。

examples.en: I asked why this transfer form had a field labeled transit number.
examples.zh: 我问这张转账表上为什么有一栏标着「加拿大银行分行编号」。

words.enDefinition: a number identifying a Canadian financial institution in payment details

examples.en: The guide explained how to find the institution number that identified the bank.
examples.zh: 指南解释了哪个数字是用于识别银行的「加拿大金融机构编号」。

examples.en: I checked the institution number on the details provided by my Canadian university.
examples.zh: 我核对了我在加拿大读的学校给出的资料上的「加拿大金融机构编号」。

words.enDefinition: an identifier used to address financial institutions in international payments

examples.en: I checked the SWIFT code on the university's official payment details sheet.
examples.zh: 我核对了学校官方付款资料单上的「银行国际识别代码」。

examples.en: The bank explained that the SWIFT code identified an institution rather than my account.
examples.zh: 银行解释说，「银行国际识别代码」识别的是机构，并非我的账户。

collocations: check the recipient bank's SWIFT code

words.enDefinition: a standardized identifier for bank accounts in participating countries

examples.en: The university sent an IBAN together with the account holder's name.
examples.zh: 学校同时发来了「国际银行账户号码」和账户持有人姓名。

examples.en: I asked whether the IBAN on my invoice matched the bank's records.
examples.zh: 我问发票上的「国际银行账户号码」是否和银行的记录相符。

words.enDefinition: a routing identifier listed for processing domestic wire payments

examples.en: I asked whether the wire routing number on this form applied to the payment type.
examples.zh: 我问这张表上的「美国电汇路由号码」是不是适用这种付款方式。

examples.en: The bank labeled the wire routing number separately from its standard account details.
examples.zh: 银行把「美国电汇路由号码」和常规账户资料分开标注。

collocations: confirm a U.S. wire routing number

words.enDefinition: a difference between a supplied name and the name on record

examples.en: The app displayed an account name mismatch, so I contacted the university for clarification.
examples.zh: 应用提示「账户名称不一致」，于是我联系学校核实。

examples.en: I asked which details had caused the account name mismatch on the payment screen.
examples.zh: 我问是哪项资料导致付款界面提示「账户名称不一致」。

words.enDefinition: a UK service that checks the name against account details

examples.en: The UK bank showed a Confirmation of Payee result before I reached the final screen.
examples.zh: 我进入最后一个页面之前，英国的银行显示了「英国收款人姓名核对」的结果。

examples.en: I asked what Confirmation of Payee meant on the bank's explanation page.
examples.zh: 我问银行说明页上的「英国收款人姓名核对」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a personal label for a saved recipient in banking software

examples.en: I gave the residence office a payee nickname that I would recognize later.
examples.zh: 我给宿舍办公室设了一个以后认得出来的「收款人自定义名称」。

examples.en: The payee nickname appeared in my app, separate from the registered account name.
examples.zh: 应用里的「收款人自定义名称」与账户登记姓名分开显示。

words.enDefinition: save a new recipient in a bank's payment list

examples.en: I asked where the option to add a beneficiary appeared in my bank app.
examples.zh: 我问银行应用上哪里有「添加收款人」的选项。

examples.en: The help page explained how the form identifies a request to add a beneficiary.
examples.zh: 帮助页说明了表格会如何标识「添加收款人」的请求。

collocations: ask how to add a beneficiary
an option to add a beneficiary

words.enDefinition: delete a saved recipient from one's payment list

examples.en: I asked where I could remove a beneficiary after moving to a different residence.
examples.zh: 搬到另一处宿舍以后，我问可以在哪里「删除已存收款人」。

examples.en: The bank said the option to remove a beneficiary was separate from the transfer screen.
examples.zh: 银行说「删除已存收款人」的选项不在转账界面上。

collocations: ask how to remove a beneficiary
an option to remove a beneficiary

words.enDefinition: the category of account to which a payment is directed

examples.en: The form asked for the recipient account type before showing the delivery estimate.
examples.zh: 表格让我先填「收款账户类型」，然后才显示预计到账时间。

examples.en: I asked the bank which part of the notice specified the recipient account type.
examples.zh: 我问银行，通知哪一部分写了「收款账户类型」。

words.enDefinition: a bank that passes the payment onward between institutions

examples.en: The bank explained why an intermediary bank appeared in the transfer record.
examples.zh: 银行解释了转账记录上为什么有一家「中转银行」。

examples.en: I asked which intermediary bank had handled the payment before it reached the recipient.
examples.zh: 我问这笔款项到收款人手里之前由哪家「中转银行」处理过。

words.enDefinition: the bank that sends a payment on behalf of the payer

examples.en: The university asked for a copy of the notice from the sending bank.
examples.zh: 学校要了一份「汇出银行」的通知副本。

examples.en: My statement showed a reference that the sending bank could use to locate the payment.
examples.zh: 账单上有一个编号，「汇出银行」可以用它查找这笔款项。

collocations: the name of the sending bank

words.enDefinition: a record confirming money was credited to the receiving account

examples.en: The university asked for proof of credit rather than the notice showing I had sent it.
examples.zh: 学校要的是「入账证明」，不是显示我已汇出的通知。

examples.en: I asked which office could provide proof of credit for the transfer under review.
examples.zh: 我问哪个部门可以为这笔正在核查的转账开具「入账证明」。

collocations: a copy of the proof of credit

words.enDefinition: payment details a sender uses to direct a wire transfer

examples.en: I asked the bursar which department could provide the official wire instructions.
examples.zh: 我问学校财务人员，哪个部门可以提供官方「电汇收款资料」。

examples.en: The wire instructions listed the institution's registered name above the account information.
examples.zh: 「电汇收款资料」把机构的登记名称列在账户信息上方。

words.enDefinition: an identifier associated with a particular transfer record

examples.en: I kept the transfer reference in case the university asked about my payment.
examples.zh: 我留了「转账查询编号」，以防学校问起我的付款。

examples.en: The bank asked for the transfer reference in order to find the transaction.
examples.zh: 银行让我提供「转账查询编号」，好调出这笔交易。

words.enDefinition: an optional note recorded alongside a payment

examples.en: I asked whether the recipient would see the payment memo on her statement.
examples.zh: 我问收款人的账单上能不能看到「付款附言」。

examples.en: The payment memo showed the room number that I had entered earlier.
examples.zh: 「付款附言」显示了我先前填的房间号。

words.enDefinition: a form field for a payment reference or identifying note

examples.en: I asked where the reference field was on the updated payment form.
examples.zh: 我问更新后的付款表上「附言填写栏」在哪里。

examples.en: The reference field appeared beneath the area for the recipient's account details.
examples.zh: 「附言填写栏」显示在填写收款账户资料的区域下方。

words.enDefinition: the reason recorded for sending a particular transfer

examples.en: The app asked me to confirm the transfer purpose before reviewing the payment.
examples.zh: 应用让我先确认「汇款用途」，再核对付款。

examples.en: I asked how the transfer purpose would appear on my copy of the form.
examples.zh: 我问我的表格副本上会怎样显示「汇款用途」。

words.enDefinition: a code representing the stated reason for a transfer

examples.en: I asked the bank what the purpose code meant on the international payment screen.
examples.zh: 我问银行，国际付款页面上的「汇款用途代码」是什么意思。

examples.en: The clerk showed me the purpose code field separately from the optional note.
examples.zh: 工作人员给我指出了「汇款用途代码」一栏，它和选填附言分开。

words.enDefinition: an identifier linking a payment to a particular invoice

examples.en: The university asked me to report the invoice reference when I queried the payment.
examples.zh: 我查询付款时，学校让我报一下「发票关联编号」。

examples.en: I found the invoice reference printed beside the total on the new invoice.
examples.zh: 我在新发票总额的旁边找到了印好的「发票关联编号」。

words.enDefinition: a document acknowledging that a transfer was submitted or paid

examples.en: I downloaded the transfer receipt after the transfer provider confirmed my request.
examples.zh: 服务商确认申请后，我下载了「转账收据」。

examples.en: The bursar asked whether the transfer receipt showed the amount and payment date.
examples.zh: 财务人员问「转账收据」上有没有写金额和付款日期。

words.enDefinition: a notice telling a payee which payment was sent and why

examples.en: I sent the remittance advice so the university could match my payment to the invoice.
examples.zh: 我发了「汇款通知单」，方便学校把我的付款和发票对上。

examples.en: The accounts office asked whether the remittance advice identified the particular term's fees.
examples.zh: 学校财务办公室问「汇款通知单」有没有写明是哪个学期的费用。

words.enDefinition: a bank record confirming that a payment instruction was sent through SWIFT

examples.en: I asked the bank for a SWIFT payment confirmation after the overseas payment was sent.
examples.zh: 海外汇款发出后，我向银行索要了「SWIFT汇款发送确认」。

examples.en: The SWIFT payment confirmation showed the sending bank but did not display the recipient's balance.
examples.zh: 「SWIFT汇款发送确认」列出了汇出银行，但不显示收款人的账户余额。

words.enDefinition: a euro transfer through a Single Euro Payments Area scheme

examples.en: The university's payment page listed a SEPA transfer as one way to pay in euros.
examples.zh: 学校付款页面把「欧元单一支付区转账」列为一种欧元付款方式。

examples.en: I asked which reference would appear on a SEPA transfer in the app.
examples.zh: 我问应用里那笔「欧元单一支付区转账」会显示哪个编号。

words.enDefinition: a UK system for sending electronic payments between participating accounts

examples.en: My UK bank listed Faster Payments as an option when I reviewed the payment.
examples.zh: 我核对付款时，英国的银行把「英国快速支付系统」列为可选方式之一。

examples.en: I asked how a transfer sent by Faster Payments would appear on my statement.
examples.zh: 我问通过「英国快速支付系统」转出的款会怎样显示在账单上。

words.enDefinition: a Federal Reserve service for settling individual wire transfers

examples.en: The U.S. bank said the payment had gone through Fedwire that morning.
examples.zh: 美国的银行说，款项当天上午通过「美联储电汇系统」处理了。

examples.en: I asked which number on the bank notice was the Fedwire reference.
examples.zh: 我问银行通知上的哪个数字是「美联储电汇系统」的编号。

words.enDefinition: a unique identifier used to track a SWIFT payment across banks

examples.en: The bank asked for the UETR before checking where the payment had reached.
examples.zh: 银行先让我提供「端到端唯一交易编号」，再查款项到了哪里。

examples.en: I found the UETR in a separate field on the payment record.
examples.zh: 我在付款记录的一个独立字段里找到了「端到端唯一交易编号」。

collocations: look up a payment by UETR

words.enDefinition: check the progress of money sent to a recipient

examples.en: The support page said where I could track a transfer using my reference number.
examples.zh: 帮助页写了在哪里用我的编号「追踪转账进度」。

examples.en: I asked whether the recipient could also track a transfer from her own account.
examples.zh: 我问收款人能不能也从她的账户「追踪转账进度」。

collocations: ask how to track a transfer
an option to track a transfer
track a transfer by its reference

words.enDefinition: the processing stage or outcome recorded for a transfer

examples.en: I checked the transfer status before replying to the university's accounts office.
examples.zh: 我先查了「转账状态」，才回复学校财务办公室。

examples.en: The provider sent me a message when the transfer status had changed.
examples.zh: 「转账状态」发生变化后，服务商给我发了一条消息。

words.enDefinition: a transfer entered in the system that is not yet complete

examples.en: I called the bank about a pending transfer that still appeared in the app.
examples.zh: 应用里还显示一笔「待处理的转账」，我就打电话向银行查询。

examples.en: The bank showed the pending transfer above the payments from the previous week.
examples.zh: 银行把「待处理的转账」显示在上周的付款记录上方。

collocations: follow up on a pending transfer

words.enDefinition: a transfer that the provider has paused and will not process until the hold is lifted

examples.en: I asked what the words transfer on hold meant in the provider's message.
examples.zh: 我问服务商消息里的「暂停处理的转账」是什么意思。

examples.en: The support team asked which transfer on hold I was calling about that afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午接我电话的客服问，我要查的是哪一笔「暂停处理的转账」。

collocations: ask about a transfer on hold
an update on a transfer on hold

words.enDefinition: a transfer that the provider is checking, for example to confirm its details

examples.en: The support agent asked for the reference of the transfer under review.
examples.zh: 客服人员请我提供这笔「正在审核的转账」的编号。

examples.en: I asked whether the provider would email me about the transfer under review.
examples.zh: 我问服务商会不会发邮件告知这笔「正在审核的转账」的情况。

collocations: a notification about a transfer under review
the reference for a transfer under review

words.enDefinition: a transfer marked by the provider as having finished processing

examples.en: The app showed a completed transfer, so I asked what that status covered.
examples.zh: 应用显示「已完成的转账」，我就问这个状态具体指什么。

examples.en: The university asked me to send the receipt for the completed transfer.
examples.zh: 学校请我发去这笔「已完成的转账」的收据。

collocations: a receipt for a completed transfer

words.enDefinition: a transfer that has been entered on an account ledger

examples.en: I matched the posted transfer with the earlier confirmation in my email.
examples.zh: 我把「已记账的转账」和之前收到的确认邮件对上了。

examples.en: The bank explained which date on my statement belonged to the posted transfer.
examples.zh: 银行说明了账单上的哪个日期对应这笔「已记账的转账」。

collocations: a posted transfer on the statement
the date of a posted transfer

words.enDefinition: added to the amount recorded in your account by the bank

examples.en: The notification read “credited to your account,” so I checked the new statement.
examples.zh: 通知写着「已记入你的账户」，所以我查看了新的对账单。

examples.en: Once the amount is credited to your account, you can see it on your statement.
examples.zh: 款项「已记入你的账户」后，就可以在对账单上看到。

collocations: a payment credited to your account
check whether it was credited to your account

words.enDefinition: money in an account is ready to use or withdraw

examples.en: The receipt gave a funds available date separate from the day I paid.
examples.zh: 收据注明了「资金可用」日期，和我付款的日子不一样。

examples.en: I asked the bank what funds available meant on that screen in the app.
examples.zh: 我问银行应用那个页面上的「资金可用」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: money sent but not yet recorded as received at its destination

examples.en: The bank's notice described the amount as funds in transit until processing finished.
examples.zh: 银行通知说，处理结束前这笔钱属于「在途资金」。

examples.en: I asked the university whether it could see the funds in transit on its side.
examples.zh: 我问学校，他们那边能不能看到这笔「在途资金」。

words.enDefinition: a money transfer that did not go through as intended

examples.en: I kept the failed transfer notice when I contacted my bank for help.
examples.zh: 我向银行求助时，把「失败的转账」通知留了下来。

examples.en: The app showed a failed transfer without saying what had caused the problem.
examples.zh: 应用显示有一笔「失败的转账」，但没说是什么原因。

words.enDefinition: a transfer that the receiving or sending service refuses to process

examples.en: The provider gave me a reason code for the rejected transfer.
examples.zh: 服务商给了我这笔「被拒绝受理的转账」对应的原因代码。

examples.en: I asked when my bank would update the record for the rejected transfer.
examples.zh: 我问银行什么时候更新那笔「被拒绝受理的转账」的记录。

collocations: a notice about a rejected transfer
check the reason for a rejected transfer

words.enDefinition: a payment that was sent back from the receiving side

examples.en: I asked who could explain the note linked to my returned transfer.
examples.zh: 我问谁能解释「已退回的转账」所附的备注。

examples.en: The bank put the returned transfer beneath the original outgoing transaction on my statement.
examples.zh: 银行在账单上把「已退回的转账」列在原来的转出记录下面。

collocations: a notice about a returned transfer

words.enDefinition: a transaction that undoes the accounting effect of an earlier transfer

examples.en: The statement showed a transfer reversal next to the original payment line.
examples.zh: 账单在原付款记录旁边显示了一笔「转账冲正」。

examples.en: I asked the bank why a transfer reversal had appeared in my account.
examples.zh: 我问银行，为什么我的账户上出现了一笔「转账冲正」。

words.enDefinition: a request to bring back funds already sent through a transfer

examples.en: The bank explained what a transfer recall meant after I asked about a wrong payment.
examples.zh: 我问错转的钱怎么办时，银行给我解释了什么是「转账追回」。

examples.en: I asked who would update me about the transfer recall on my payment record.
examples.zh: 我问谁会通知我付款记录上那笔「转账追回」的进展。

collocations: check the status of a transfer recall

words.enDefinition: stop a pending or scheduled transfer when the provider allows it

examples.en: I asked whether it was still possible to cancel a transfer scheduled for Wednesday.
examples.zh: 我问能不能「取消预约在周三执行的转账」。

examples.en: The provider's help page explained when customers could ask to cancel a transfer.
examples.zh: 服务商的帮助页解释了客户什么时候可以申请「取消转账」。

collocations: the option to cancel a transfer

words.enDefinition: a second payment that repeats the same intended transfer

examples.en: I called the bank because the two entries looked like a duplicate transfer.
examples.zh: 这两条记录看起来像「重复转账」，我就给银行打了电话。

examples.en: The support agent compared the references before identifying a duplicate transfer on the statement.
examples.zh: 客服先对照了编号，然后确认账单上有一笔「重复转账」。

words.enDefinition: a transfer not found where the sender or recipient expected it

examples.en: I gave the bank the date when asking about the missing transfer.
examples.zh: 我询问「未能查到的转账」时，把日期也提供给了银行。

examples.en: The university requested the payment reference for the missing transfer that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午，学校向我要了这笔「未能查到的转账」的付款编号。

collocations: an inquiry about a missing transfer

words.enDefinition: a transfer taking longer than originally expected to reach its destination

examples.en: The provider texted me an update about the delayed transfer during my tutorial.
examples.zh: 我上辅导课时，服务商发短信更新了「延迟到账的转账」的情况。

examples.en: I asked whether the delayed transfer had a revised arrival estimate yet.
examples.zh: 我问「延迟到账的转账」有没有更新预计到账时间。

collocations: a notice about a delayed transfer

words.enDefinition: a transfer waiting for the intended recipient to collect it

examples.en: The provider contacted me about an unclaimed transfer left at the collection point.
examples.zh: 服务商来联系我，说领取点有一笔「未领取的汇款」。

examples.en: I asked why the receipt showed an unclaimed transfer after the weekend.
examples.zh: 我问为什么过了周末，收据上还显示有一笔「未领取的汇款」。

collocations: follow up on an unclaimed transfer

words.enDefinition: an inquiry into what happened to a particular transfer

examples.en: The bank assigned a case number to the transfer investigation I asked about.
examples.zh: 银行给我询问的这次「转账调查」分配了案件编号。

examples.en: I asked when the provider would contact me about the transfer investigation.
examples.zh: 我问服务商什么时候会就「转账调查」联系我。

collocations: a reference for a transfer investigation
an update on the transfer investigation

words.enDefinition: a request for a bank to locate or track a payment

examples.en: My bank submitted a trace request after I reported the missing payment.
examples.zh: 我报告款项没找到以后，银行提交了「资金去向查询申请」。

examples.en: The provider gave me a copy of the trace request for my records.
examples.zh: 服务商给了我一份「资金去向查询申请」副本留档。

collocations: follow up on a trace request

words.enDefinition: money paid back to the sender after a transfer is cancelled or returned

examples.en: I found a transfer refund on the statement for the previous month.
examples.zh: 我在上个月的账单上找到了一笔「转账退款」。

examples.en: The provider told me how the transfer refund would appear in my account.
examples.zh: 服务商告诉我，「转账退款」会在账户里怎样显示。

collocations: an update on a transfer refund

words.enDefinition: a payment for less than the amount due

examples.en: The university contacted me about a short payment after matching the invoice.
examples.zh: 学校核对发票后联系我，说这笔款「付款金额不足」。

examples.en: I asked whether the short payment was related to the fee shown on the notice.
examples.zh: 我问「付款金额不足」是不是和通知上显示的费用有关。

words.enDefinition: an amount charged by a bank for moving money

examples.en: The bank listed a bank transfer fee separately from the money being sent.
examples.zh: 银行把「银行转账手续费」和汇出的款项分开列出。

examples.en: I asked how the bank transfer fee appeared on my monthly account statement.
examples.zh: 我问月度账户账单上会怎样显示「银行转账手续费」。

words.enDefinition: a bank charge for sending a wire payment

examples.en: I noticed an outgoing wire fee on my bank statement after the payment.
examples.zh: 付款后，我注意到账单上有个「电汇汇出费」。

examples.en: The branch explained where the outgoing wire fee would be shown on the receipt.
examples.zh: 分行说明了收据上哪里会列出「电汇汇出费」。

collocations: an outgoing wire fee on the statement

words.enDefinition: a bank charge for receiving a wire payment

examples.en: The recipient asked her bank whether it charged an incoming wire fee.
examples.zh: 收款人问她的银行会不会收「电汇入账费」。

examples.en: I asked why the notice included a separate line for the incoming wire fee.
examples.zh: 我问通知为什么单独列了一行「电汇入账费」。

collocations: an incoming wire fee on the statement

words.enDefinition: a charge by a bank forwarding a payment along its route

examples.en: I asked which charge on the receipt was an intermediary bank fee.
examples.zh: 我问收据上哪笔收费是「中转银行手续费」。

examples.en: The support agent explained why there was a separate intermediary bank fee.
examples.zh: 客服解释了为什么会有一笔单独的「中转银行手续费」。

words.enDefinition: a charge for changing information in an existing transfer instruction

examples.en: The clerk explained when the bank would charge a transfer amendment fee.
examples.zh: 工作人员解释了银行什么情况下会收「转账更改费」。

examples.en: I asked if a transfer amendment fee would appear separately on the receipt.
examples.zh: 我问「转账更改费」会不会在收据上单独显示。

collocations: ask about a transfer amendment fee

words.enDefinition: a transfer charge stated as a set amount

examples.en: The provider listed a fixed transfer fee next to the delivery estimate.
examples.zh: 服务商在预计到账时间旁边列了「固定转账手续费」。

examples.en: I asked whether the fixed transfer fee changed for a different delivery option.
examples.zh: 我问换一种到账方式，「固定转账手续费」会不会变。

collocations: a fixed transfer fee per transaction

words.enDefinition: a charge calculated as a percentage of an amount

examples.en: The quote showed a percentage fee beside the separate fixed charge.
examples.zh: 报价同时列了「按比例收费」和单独的固定费用。

examples.en: I asked which amount the service used to calculate its percentage fee.
examples.zh: 我问服务商用哪个金额来计算「按比例收费」。

collocations: a percentage fee on the amount sent

words.enDefinition: transfer fees assigned to the person sending the money

examples.en: I asked the bank what sender-paid charges included on this form.
examples.zh: 我问银行，这张表上的「汇款人承担的费用」包括哪些。

examples.en: The app listed sender-paid charges separately from charges paid by the recipient.
examples.zh: 应用把「汇款人承担的费用」和收款人承担的费用分开列。

words.enDefinition: transfer fees assigned to the person receiving the money

examples.en: I asked whether beneficiary-paid charges would affect the amount my roommate received.
examples.zh: 我问「收款人承担的费用」会不会影响室友实际收到的金额。

examples.en: The bank explained what beneficiary-paid charges meant in the fee options.
examples.zh: 银行解释了收费选项里的「收款人承担的费用」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: transfer fees divided between the sender and recipient under stated terms

examples.en: I asked what shared charges meant because the fee description was unclear.
examples.zh: 费用说明写得不清楚，我就问「双方分担的费用」是什么意思。

examples.en: The bank explained how shared charges would appear on each statement.
examples.zh: 银行说明了「双方分担的费用」会怎样显示在各自的账单上。

collocations: check how shared charges are allocated

words.enDefinition: the maximum sum or number of transfers permitted in a day

examples.en: I asked the bank whether the daily transfer limit shown applied to my account.
examples.zh: 我问银行，页面上显示的「每日转账限额」是否适用于我的账户。

examples.en: The website explained where to check a daily transfer limit for an overseas payment.
examples.zh: 网站说明了到哪里查询海外付款的「每日转账限额」。

collocations: ask about the daily transfer limit

words.enDefinition: the smallest sum a provider accepts for a transfer

examples.en: The quote page listed a minimum transfer amount before showing the conversion rate.
examples.zh: 报价页面先列出「最低转账金额」，再显示兑换汇率。

examples.en: I asked whether the minimum transfer amount changed for different ways of receiving money.
examples.zh: 我问换一种收款方式，「最低转账金额」会不会变。

collocations: a minimum transfer amount required by the provider

words.enDefinition: a currency that a service cannot handle for a particular transaction

examples.en: The app showed an unsupported currency message when I checked the delivery options.
examples.zh: 我查看到账方式时，应用显示了「暂不支持的币种」提示。

examples.en: I asked whether the receipt would still show the unsupported currency I had entered.
examples.zh: 我问收据会不会还显示我填的那个「暂不支持的币种」。

collocations: a transfer in an unsupported currency

words.enDefinition: a listing showing the components of a total fee

examples.en: I downloaded the fee breakdown before filing the transfer receipt with my records.
examples.zh: 把转账收据归档前，我先下载了「手续费明细」。

examples.en: I asked whether the fee breakdown included fees from the receiving bank.
examples.zh: 我问「手续费明细」是否包含入账银行收的费用。

words.enDefinition: the overall amount paid for a transfer including applicable charges

examples.en: The quote showed the total transfer cost on a separate line at the bottom.
examples.zh: 报价底部单独列了一行「汇款总支出」。

examples.en: I asked which charges were included in the stated total transfer cost.
examples.zh: 我问列出的「汇款总支出」里包括哪些费用。

words.enDefinition: the amount that reaches the recipient after relevant deductions

examples.en: The university reported the net amount received after checking its account statement.
examples.zh: 学校核对账户账单后，告诉了我「实际到账净额」。

examples.en: I asked which figure on the notice was the net amount received.
examples.zh: 我问通知上的哪个金额是「实际到账净额」。

words.enDefinition: the sum taken from the account used for payment

examples.en: I checked whether the amount debited included the separate transfer fee.
examples.zh: 我核对了「账户扣款总额」是否包含单独列出的转账手续费。

examples.en: The bank showed the amount debited on the line below my reference.
examples.zh: 银行把「账户扣款总额」显示在我的编号下方那一行。

collocations: the amount debited from the account

words.enDefinition: a statement giving an offered or estimated conversion rate

examples.en: I asked how long the exchange rate quote would stay on the screen.
examples.zh: 我问「汇率报价」会在那个页面显示多久。

examples.en: The bank sent me an exchange rate quote with the transfer estimate.
examples.zh: 银行连同转账预估，给我发来了一份「汇率报价」。

collocations: the expiry of an exchange rate quote

words.enDefinition: the midpoint between market rates for buying and selling currencies

examples.en: The provider's guide explained what the mid-market exchange rate represented on its page.
examples.zh: 服务商指南解释了网站上的「市场中间汇率」代表什么。

examples.en: I asked whether the quote used the mid-market exchange rate in its calculation.
examples.zh: 我问这份报价计算时是否用了「市场中间汇率」。

collocations: compare with the mid-market exchange rate

words.enDefinition: an exchange rate reserved for a transaction under specified conditions

examples.en: The confirmation said when the locked-in rate for my transfer would expire.
examples.zh: 确认通知说了我这笔转账的「锁定汇率」什么时候失效。

examples.en: I asked which line on the receipt showed the locked-in rate.
examples.zh: 我问收据上的哪一行显示「锁定汇率」。

words.enDefinition: an estimated rate shown for guidance without a guaranteed quote

examples.en: The app showed an indicative exchange rate before I asked for the final quote.
examples.zh: 我申请最终报价之前，应用先显示了一个「参考汇率」。

examples.en: I asked what made the indicative exchange rate different from the confirmed rate.
examples.zh: 我问「参考汇率」和已确认的汇率有什么区别。

collocations: an indicative exchange rate on screen

words.enDefinition: the difference between quoted buying and selling rates for currencies

examples.en: The provider's guide showed how it described an exchange rate spread.
examples.zh: 服务商指南展示了他们如何解释「买卖汇率价差」。

examples.en: I asked which two displayed rates made up the exchange rate spread.
examples.zh: 我问页面上显示的哪两个汇率构成「买卖汇率价差」。

collocations: the size of an exchange rate spread

words.enDefinition: a pricing margin included in a rate relative to a benchmark

examples.en: The support page explained what the provider called an exchange rate markup.
examples.zh: 帮助页面解释了服务商所说的「汇率加价」是什么意思。

examples.en: I asked where the transfer quote showed the exchange rate markup.
examples.zh: 我问转账报价上哪里显示了「汇率加价」。

collocations: an exchange rate markup on a quote

words.enDefinition: the exchange of an amount from one currency into another

examples.en: The receipt listed a separate line for the currency conversion.
examples.zh: 收据上单独列了一行「币种兑换」。

examples.en: I asked which provider would handle the currency conversion for my payment.
examples.zh: 我问哪家服务商会处理我的付款所需的「币种兑换」。

words.enDefinition: the amount stated after applying a currency exchange rate

examples.en: I checked the converted amount in the quote before reviewing the fees.
examples.zh: 我先核对报价上的「兑换后金额」，然后才看手续费用。

examples.en: The app displayed the converted amount beside the original transfer amount.
examples.zh: 应用在原转账金额的旁边显示了「兑换后金额」。

collocations: the converted amount on the quote

words.enDefinition: the currency specified for the amount being sent

examples.en: I asked which field on the form showed the sending currency.
examples.zh: 我问表格上的哪个字段显示「汇出币种」。

examples.en: The quote changed when I selected a different sending currency.
examples.zh: 我选了另一种「汇出币种」之后，报价变了。

words.enDefinition: the currency in which the recipient is to receive money

examples.en: I asked whether the quote listed the correct payout currency for the recipient.
examples.zh: 我问报价上是否给收款人列了正确的「兑付币种」。

examples.en: The service displayed the payout currency beside the estimated delivery amount.
examples.zh: 服务商在预计到账金额旁边显示了「兑付币种」。

words.enDefinition: the sum a provider expects the recipient to get

examples.en: The quote showed the estimated amount received after the listed deductions.
examples.zh: 报价显示了扣除列出的费用后的「预计实收金额」。

examples.en: I asked how the estimated amount received differed from the original transfer amount.
examples.zh: 我问「预计实收金额」和原转账金额有什么区别。

collocations: an estimated amount received in local currency

words.enDefinition: the way a sender provides money to pay for a transfer

examples.en: The app asked me to confirm the funding method before reviewing my receipt.
examples.zh: 应用让我先确认「汇款扣款方式」，再查看收据。

examples.en: I asked if a different funding method would change the processing time.
examples.zh: 我问换一种「汇款扣款方式」会不会影响处理时间。

words.enDefinition: information supplied before payment about terms, rates, charges, and expected delivery

examples.en: The provider showed the pre-payment disclosure before asking me to confirm.
examples.zh: 服务商先展示了「付款前信息披露」，才让我确认。

examples.en: I checked whether the pre-payment disclosure listed the projected delivery date.
examples.zh: 我核对了「付款前信息披露」有没有列出预计到账日期。

collocations: a copy of the pre-payment disclosure

words.enDefinition: a form for requesting a bank to send a wire payment

examples.en: The bank sent a copy of the wire transfer request form to my inbox.
examples.zh: 银行把「电汇申请表」的副本发到了我的邮箱。

examples.en: I asked which section of the wire transfer request form showed the recipient's bank.
examples.zh: 我问「电汇申请表」的哪个部分填写收款银行。

collocations: complete a wire transfer request form
submit a wire transfer request form
a blank wire transfer request form
